record.question:
The first phase of the India Census 2027 officially commenced on 1st April, 2026 to cover the entire
    population in the country using digital tools. Against this backdrop, which Ministry of the Government
    of India is primarily responsible for conducting the Census of India?
options: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
